_comment: T2 The Shallows fauna as designed on the Bestiary Grid (user, 2026-09-06): four per district in the flooded Shallows floors (0-92 ft) plus four open-water hunters. Design source for tools/build_fauna.py. hp/damage/speed literal; drops are free-text and are mapped onto existing materials by the builder (unique trophy items are not created).

industrial-t2-1.look: elongated metallic-grey eel with sharp rusted crests along its spine
industrial-t2-1.name: rust-crested eel
industrial-t2-1.special: inflicts minor shock damage over time

industrial-t2-2.lives: Submerged oil vats and pipes (0-92 ft)
industrial-t2-2.look: bulky crab coated in dark oily sludge and pipe fragments
industrial-t2-2.name: sludge crab

industrial-t2-3.look: thick leech-like fish with glowing red heated throat rings
industrial-t2-3.name: boiler lamprey

industrial-t2-4.look: slick black sea snake dripping slick chemical residue
industrial-t2-4.name: grease viper

construction-t2-1.look: massive snapping turtle with rebar fused into its shell and jaw
construction-t2-1.name: rebar snapping turtle

construction-t2-2.attack: whips tail and buries player in silt
construction-t2-2.look: flat grey stingray disguised as a slab of cracked concrete
construction-t2-2.name: concrete ray

construction-t2-3.look: colony of jagged barnacles attached to corroded iron structural beams
construction-t2-3.name: scaffolding barnacle

construction-t2-4.attack: rams player and stirs up blinding mud
construction-t2-4.look: armored catfish with heavy stone-like scales and long sensory barbels
construction-t2-4.name: silt-dredger catfish

business-t2-1.look: translucent predatory fish with long dark stealth-like tentacles
business-t2-1.name: silt stalker

business-t2-2.attack: shoots ink infused with pulp shreds
business-t2-2.look: pale squid draped in shredded waterlogged documents and office supplies
business-t2-2.name: document squid

business-t2-3.attack: blinds with bright flash then bites
business-t2-3.drops: LED bulb organic bulb, glass fragment
business-t2-3.look: vicious deep-sea anglerfish with a flickering digital sign bulb stalk
business-t2-3.name: LED anglerfish
business-t2-3.special: stuns targets in range with light flash

business-t2-4.look: dark sleek eel nesting inside rusted safe deposit boxes
business-t2-4.name: vault moray
business-t2-4.special: high critical hit chance from hiding

residential-t2-1.lives: Flooded living rooms and roofs (0-92 ft)
residential-t2-1.look: large segmented leech covered in sharp shell-like barnacle plating
residential-t2-1.name: barnacle leech

residential-t2-2.attack: pounces and bites with webbed jaws
residential-t2-2.look: feral hound with webbed paws, slick skin, and external gills
residential-t2-2.name: submerged hound

residential-t2-3.look: long narrow predatory fish with razor-sharp teeth protruding outward
residential-t2-3.name: gutter pike

residential-t2-4.lives: Flooded home aquariums and bedrooms (0-92 ft)
residential-t2-4.look: overgrown vibrant red betta fish with sharp serrated tail fins
residential-t2-4.name: aquarium betta

commercial-t2-1.look: glowing neon-colored jellyfish pulsing with static charge
commercial-t2-1.name: neon jellyfish

commercial-t2-2.look: colorful mantis shrimp carrying fragments of shattered glass as armor
commercial-t2-2.name: display-case mantis shrimp

commercial-t2-3.look: swarm of small skeleton crabs clinging to wire shopping carts
commercial-t2-3.name: cart skeleton crabs

commercial-t2-4.attack: glides over player and whips tail
commercial-t2-4.look: wide flat ray with glowing marketing-patterned spots across its back
commercial-t2-4.name: billboard stingray

civil-t2-1.attack: grabs with suckers and pulls into pipes
civil-t2-1.lives: Drainage systems and main pipes (0-92 ft)
civil-t2-1.look: dark mottled octopus emerging from a heavy cast-iron drain pipe
civil-t2-1.name: drain pipe octopus

civil-t2-2.lives: Flooded subway lines and sewers (0-92 ft)
civil-t2-2.look: pale, blind alligator encrusted with sewer grime and iron rust
civil-t2-2.name: sewer gator

civil-t2-3.lives: Flooded culverts and water tunnels (0-92 ft)
civil-t2-3.look: slimy eel-like hagfish wrapped around rusted civil plumbing
civil-t2-3.name: culvert hagfish
civil-t2-3.special: slime coat reduces incoming physical damage

civil-t2-4.attack: shoots sharp spines in all directions
civil-t2-4.look: spiky sea urchin attached to a rusty valve handle
civil-t2-4.name: valve urchin

open-water-t2-1.look: grey sleek reef shark with sharp serrated fins
open-water-t2-1.name: reef shark
open-water-t2-1.special: gains speed when player is injured

open-water-t2-2.attack: charges at high speed with lower jaw strike
open-water-t2-2.look: silver long-bodied barracuda with glowing yellow eyes
open-water-t2-2.name: depth barracuda

open-water-t2-3.look: dense shimmering silver bait ball of hundreds of tiny fish
open-water-t2-3.name: swarm anchovy
open-water-t2-3.special: hard to hit with single-target attacks

open-water-t2-4.look: ornate red and white lionfish with long fan-like poisonous spines
open-water-t2-4.name: chasm lionfish
